title: Ugali
description: A staple Kenyan dish made from maize flour.
instructions: Boil water, gradually add maize flour while stirring until firm.

title: Chapati
description: Soft layered flatbread popular in East Africa.
instructions: Knead dough, roll flat, cook on skillet until golden.

title: Sukuma Wiki
description: Delicious collard greens sautéed with onions and tomatoes.
instructions: Fry onions, add tomatoes, cook greens until tender.
